items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Professor Nixon's aunt and uncle had a school right there, a place called St. James Hall

ctx.x: You never even went to school until six or seven I could give school.

No. From the age of around six, seven years old until I was ten, I used to play school on the gut age at night with the kids that went to school. And when I went to school at ten years old, it was a private school. Professor Nixon's aunt and uncle had a school right there, a place called St. James Hall, right back at St. James Methodist Church. St. James on Roman Street and the hall was on Durbanee, right next to Muller's Pfanneshof factory. I don't know if it was there yet.
